title: Synthesis (~06:45Z): heredity and selection established in the reacting thermals; ecology candidates reviewed into prey-predator pairs; flows that propel are flows with a curl, and c53's gravity-free fed vortices are the next class to push
summary: Since c49's 03:49Z synthesis: the thermals selection claim (SIMDH) is established, the first class where the same individuals swim 3+ lengths between birth and division and breed true under selection on in-run variants (written yield trait, gravity-set direction). The Marangoni ladder, sink-escape advantage and screen, c46's hunting-ecology controls and predator division, and the CIPS chemostat are established; the thermals local cut is Weak (the strip drains its neighbours). c52's digestion ecology replicates on a fresh seed but 89% of its predators sit on prey, so whether the pair is the individual decides it. Next: c53's fed-vortex dipoles, a thermals trait that acts on buoyancy, and a pair-identity measurement for c52.
